reason: My rental shop doesn't have that many receipts. Staff send them to the group, I look at them, and my partner and I go through the month together. A duplicate means I talk to the person, and a bot can't do that for me. I'd try the 40 free ones out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $19 a month for something I can do in an evening with a spreadsheet.
objection: It's another subscription fixing a problem I don't really have. My volume is low, and if someone fiddles a receipt, that's about trust in my staff, not software.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial found real money in my old chat history, like duplicates or overcharges I'd missed that add up to more than a few months of the fee.
